title: Contrix Place
description: A Place is a structural grouping object inside a Space. Boards, lists, swimlanes, calendar buckets, document outline groups, etc. are all Places. Authorization-transparent: never carries its own membership/policy/E2EE group; resolves to the containing Space.

space_id.description: Owning Space (security boundary). MUST point to a cx:space: id; MUST NOT point to another cx:place: id.

parent_ref.description: Optional parent in the structural hierarchy. May be a cx:place: (e.g., a list whose parent is a board) or the same cx:space: as space_id when this Place is at the Space root. If omitted, the Place is at Space root.

kind.description: Place kind. v1 standard kinds include 'board', 'list'. Profile-defined kinds (e.g., 'swimlane', 'calendar_bucket', 'page_group') MAY be added via Space schema/profile and MUST be registered. Unknown kind MUST schema_violation.

rank.description: Fractional-index rank within parent. See encoding.md §9.

schema_refs.description: Optional schema/profile references that further constrain this Place's contained Flow types, fields, or position invariants.

fields.description: Place kind-specific fields, e.g., { 'wip_limit': 5 } for kind=list, { 'view_id': 'cx:view:...' } for kind=board's default view.

state.description: Place lifecycle state. 'active' is the default; 'archived' is set by cx.place.archive (reversible UI hide); 'tombstoned' is set by cx.place.tombstone (irreversible; tombstoning a Place that still has live Flow references MUST schema_violation, relocation MUST happen first). The transition timestamp lives on the writing Move and on state_changed_at.

state_changed_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent state transition. Required when state != 'active'.
